title: CIA-UAP-002, Scientific Advisory Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects, Report, 1952-1953
doc_notes: This is a declassified CIA report from a scientific advisory panel evaluating UAP sightings, which concludes that most sightings are misidentifications and recommends de-emphasizing the subject.

encounters.summary: A sighting of objects in Tremonton, Utah, involving motion picture film analyzed by the USN Photo Interpretation Laboratory.
encounters.quote: The Panel Members were impressed by the evident industry and extent of effort of the P.I.L. team, they could not accept the conclusions reached.

encounters.summary: Reports of 'Foo Fighters' by Allied pilots during World War II, described as balls of light flying near aircraft.
encounters.entity_behavior: fly near or with aircraft and maneuver rapidly
encounters.quote: Instances of 'Foo Fighters' were cited. These were unexplained phenomena sighted by Allied pilots during World War II
